prompt: Create one static desktop UI reference image for an unbranded research room-reconstruction comparison viewer, landscape. Dark near-black background, muted warm gray text, restrained amber for inferred geometry. Central large 3D viewport shows a generic sparse RGB point-cloud room, incomplete furniture and clearly hollow-square authored boundary walls, not polished or invented complete furniture. Minimal control strip above viewport: model buttons 'VGGT' and 'WorldMirror 2.0', small subtitle 'Same 7 photos · Room 42445021 · Relative scale'. Below model controls, small existing-style buttons 'Raw estimate', 'CPU fused', 'Authored enclosure'. WorldMirror button is selected with clear outline and text. Small controls for 'Points / Surfaces', 'Paris matrix / Uniform dots', 'Source colors', and source-view selection. Bottom short note 'Unconfirmed boundary · No SAM 3D completion'. A quiet secondary 'Broader-view study' link separates an authored study from the matched model comparison. Sparse utilitarian controls with generous spacing, keyboard-visible focus on one button, legible labels, no dashboard cards, charts, animations, gradients, glowing effects, logos or new branding. Use Space Grotesk-like headings and IBM Plex Sans-like body. This is a control-layout and evidence-label reference only, not a source photograph or reconstruction result. Preserve attention on the room viewport and show no claim of measured geometry or quality acceptance.
